checks.title: Journal of Economic History
checks.note: Publisher remit covers economic phenomena historically, across regions, periods and methods. Print and online ISSNs checked on the same page. Founding dates not checked.

checks.title: Holocaust and Genocide Studies
checks.note: Publisher identifies a peer-reviewed research venue for Holocaust and other genocide scholarship. Print and online ISSNs checked. Genocide journals generally are not thereby classified as Holocaust journals. Founding dates not checked.

checks.title: Journal of Social History
checks.note: Publisher describes social-history research across regions, from the early modern period onward. Link concerns subject coverage, not adherence to every programme in the New social history atlas entry.

checks.title: Gender & History
checks.note: Publisher remit covers femininity, masculinity and gender relations across historical contexts. Venue links concern these subjects, not every argument or strand in the atlas entries.

checks.title: Oral History Review
checks.note: Publisher remit explicitly covers oral-history theory and practice. Founding date and ISSNs not checked.

checks.title: Journal of the History of Sexuality
checks.note: Official journal about-page indexed extract: established in 1990; cross-cultural research on sexuality. The journal is broader than queer theory. Full-page retrieval timed out.

checks.title: Journal of Interdisciplinary History
checks.note: Publisher describes historical research using other disciplines across periods and regions. Specific quantitative and demographic programme links proposed in opusreview.md still need evidence; interdisciplinary is not a synonym for quantitative.

checks.title: Journal of American History
checks.note: Publisher identifies broad American-history remit. This alone does not establish affiliation with Progressive, consensus or New Left historiography.

checks.title: Journal of African American History
checks.note: Publisher documents African American history remit, founding in 1916 under the former Journal of Negro History title, and change to the current title in 2002. Current-title ISSNs must not be assigned to the predecessor.

checks.title: Journal of Negro History
checks.note: JSTOR title-history record identifies the 1916–2001 title run and successor Journal of African American History from 2002. The end refers to this title, not the end of the continuing journal or Black history.

checks.title: Isis
checks.note: Publisher remit includes history of science, medicine and technology; inception given as 1912. Venue relationships do not indicate that these fields lack disagreement.

checks.title: Osiris
checks.note: Publisher identifies a thematic history-of-science journal, founded in 1936 and relaunched in 1985. Interruption boundaries not checked; no continuous-publication assumption. Existing science field provides an anchor despite Pattern A in opusreview.md.

checks.title: Indian Economic and Social History Review
checks.note: Publisher remit concerns economic and social history of India and South Asia. Subject links do not equate Indian historical traditions with a Western school; the regional and institutional coverage gap remains.

checks.title: Cross-Currents: East Asian History and Culture Review
checks.note: University repository describes an East Asian history and culture journal archive for 2011–2020. This verifies archive coverage, not by itself cessation of every print or electronic manifestation.

archive_coverage.note: Repository archive coverage; cessation not separately confirmed.

checks.title: Asia Pacific Perspectives
checks.note: University publisher describes peer-reviewed humanities and social-science research on the Asia Pacific. The region studied is distinct from publisher location; no Western-school affiliation inferred.

checks.title: Representations
checks.note: Publisher scope includes cultural inquiry, history and gender studies. Subject links do not imply exclusive adherence to one cultural-history school.

checks.title: New Left Review
checks.note: Journal self-description includes history, social theory, politics and culture; launch in 1960. Its British origins do not make it identical to the atlas US New Left entry.

checks.title: Critical Inquiry
checks.note: Official journal overview describes interdisciplinary critical thought in arts and humanities and foundation in 1974; historical articles require more specific venue links.

checks.title: Signs: Journal of Women in Culture and Society
checks.note: Publisher describes interdisciplinary feminist scholarship on gender, race, culture and sexuality. Specific historical programme or debate links remain to be checked.
